muc.title: Saving hundreds of videos
muc.text: You've saved hundreds of how-to videos. After watching, how much do you remember?

muc.title: The transcript
muc.text: Most videos have a transcript. On YouTube, open the description, choose show transcript, then copy it.

muc.title: Paste it into AI
muc.text: Paste the transcript into AI. Some apps, like Gemini, can even read a YouTube link directly.

muc.title: Ask AI for three things
muc.text: Then ask AI for three things. One: quiz you on the content, one question at a time. Two: re-explain the hard parts with everyday examples. Three: make flashcards for review.

muc.title: Don't wait until the end
muc.text: Even better, don't wait until you've watched it all. Watch ten minutes, paste that part in, answer a few questions, then keep watching.

muc.title: AI makes mistakes too
muc.text: Remember, AI summaries can be wrong too. If something sounds odd, rewind to that part of the video to check.

muc.title: 5 questions
muc.text: Pick a video you just watched, paste its transcript into AI and say: ask me five questions about this video, one at a time, and only ask the next one after I answer.

muc.title: Lectures into exercises
muc.text: Videos have transcripts. What about slides and lecture notes? Part three: turn lectures into exercises.
